{{Quote|With the unexpected arrival of Hansor’s Hooligans at Sedratis City last night, the local sports world has focused on what must be acknowledged as a dramatic turn of events.|A news report included in the fiftieth-anniversary edition of ''Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology''|<ref name="Galladinium" />}}
'''Sedratis City''' was situated in the [[Sedratis system/Legends|Sedratis system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained the [[Sedratis Coliseum]], and [[Demelza's Destructors]] were the [[City/Legends|city's]] premier [[gladiator walker]] combat team. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Destructors' bitter rivals, [[Hansor's Hooligans]], unexpectedly arrived in Sedratis City and, taking up residence at the Sedratis Coliseum, challenged the city's team to try and evict them. In response, fan demand soared for tickets to the showdown between the two teams.

==Description==
{{Quote|Having apparently worked out the details in secret with local promoters months ago, Hansor's team has taken up residence in the Sedratis Coliseum and has issued a challenge to the Destructors to evict him if they can!|A news report included in the fiftieth-anniversary edition of ''Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology''|<ref name="Galladinium" />}}
Sedratis City was a [[City/Legends|settlement]]<ref name="Galladinium" /> located in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Sedratis system/Legends|Sedratis system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the site of the structure known as the [[Sedratis Coliseum]].<ref name="Galladinium" />

==History==
{{Quote|As is well known, Madrix Hansor and his four teammates have had a long-standing rivalry with Sedratis City’s premier gladiator walker team, Demelza’s Destructors.|A news report included in the fiftieth-anniversary edition of ''Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology''|<ref name="Galladinium" />}}
[[File:Sedratis-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Sedratis City was located in the Sedratis system (galactic surroundings pictured).]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Demelza's Destructors]], a member of the [[Core Gladiator Walker League]], was the premier [[gladiator walker]] team of Sedratis City. Few believed that [[Hansor's Hooligans]], a team that had a bitter rivalry with the Destructors, would travel the considerable distance to the city in order to issue a personal challenge to their competitors. However, the Hooligans' captain [[Madrix Hansor]] planned to do exactly that, secretly making arrangements with local promoters [[Standard month/Legends|months]] in advance.<ref name="Galladinium" />

Finally,<ref name="Galladinium" /> at some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' is set during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Hansor's team arrived in Sedratis City, surprising fans of the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] sport. The Hooligans took up residence at the Sedratis Coliseum and challenged the Destructors to evict them. Over the subsequent twelve [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], the demand for tickets to the expected showdown between the two teams overwhelmed electronic ticketing systems, and a news report from the [[Local day/Legends|day]] after the issuing of the challenge that mentioned the events in Sedratis City was subsequently included in the [[Galladinium's 50th anniversary edition|fiftieth-anniversary edition]] of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sedratis City was mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />
